items.title: Dell Is Down 16% in a Week. Steve Eisman Warns It “Will Also Slow Along With Nvidia.” Time to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDell stock fell 16% in the past week as AI hardware sold off after Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO, and Super Micro and CoreWeave fell too. Steve Eisman warns Dell will slow along with Nvidia, but Cisco just raised its AI forecast and analysts have raised Dell’s earnings estimates slightly.
